svg.aria-label: Sketch: the New River Gorge Bridge seen from below on the gorge floor, its steel arch sweeping up from the lower left and down to the right into a wooded hillside, the deck truss running across the top of the frame on spandrel columns braced with X lattice. Autumn trees frame the left and a bare branch with scattered leaves hangs in at upper right; a single cloud sits over the far ridge under the arch. A few lines hang from the deck. No people are shown. Drawn after a WV MetroNews photograph of the bridge at Bridge Day.
